scope: permutation-equivariant set-context scene head selected only on authorized development folds

target_domain.training_use: supervised domain definition on authorized development sites

search.rank_rule: worst low-prevalence fold AP, combined low-prevalence AP, worst fold recall, combined recall, then smaller blend

gates.selection_and_confirmation: low-prevalence AP point delta positive with positive paired site-bootstrap lower bound; recall point delta nonnegative

base_architecture.name: frozen v3 stronger OOF ExtraTrees scene head

interpretation.architecture: regularized gradient-boosted permutation-equivariant surrogate for a Deep Sets / multiple-instance scene head
interpretation.instance_features: 108 deterministic scene features plus frozen site-context features
interpretation.set_features: current-score mean/std/max/q90, leave-one-out max, within-site rank, and site size
interpretation.routing_at_inference: known training sites remain current; unseen sites use only label-free scene/set features

invariants: Every selection score is cross-fitted by physical-site fold.
The fixed winner is trained on folds 2/3/4 and confirmed once on folds 0/1.
The prevalence threshold never enters inference features or routing.
Failure writes no artifact and blocks fresh-safety and paper replay.
